notes.claim: A best-fit line mimics the trend and may miss most plotted points; the idea is a line with equal numbers of points either side.
A force against extension graph is a straight line through the origin only while the limit of proportionality is not exceeded.
One student read the y intercept of a best-fit line as the work done against friction.

sources.title: What is described by Hooke's law in GCSE Physics? - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: Provided that the limit of proportionality is not exceeded , a graph of stretching force against extension is a straight line through the origin

sources.title: How Do I Construct a Straight Line through Data Points? Best-Fit Lines
sources.quote: In many cases, the line may not pass through very many of the plotted points. Instead, the idea is to get a line that has equal numbers of points on either side.

sources.title: untitled
sources.quote: she stated that the best- fit line enabled her to calculate the moment of inertia and the work done against friction, which is represented graphically as the y intercept
